# proxmox_cluster_config (Data Source)

Reads the corosync configuration of the cluster: `/cluster/config/totem`, `/cluster/config/apiversion` and the member nodes from `/cluster/config/nodes`. Values are exposed as JSON strings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_cluster_config" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `apiversion` (String) Corosync API version.
- `nodes` (List of String)
- `totem` (Map of String)
